unique_value: actor-role/object-type/verb authority is expressed as an explicit default-deny matrix rather than scattered role checks
exact and wildcard grants produce distinguishable decision reasons and fingerprints
the actual matched grant is exposed in the decision receipt
malformed request dimensions refuse without throwing open

capability_contribution.ownership: This repository remains the canonical Palantir-lens specialist for object-type/verb authorization; lineage and writeback remain separate control planes.

relationships.boundary: causal provenance does not determine authorization
authorization may gate future writeback, but executable receipt binding has not yet been exercised

next_evolution: Add explicitly modeled deny rules and property/effect/time scopes only after preserving the current default-deny contract; then bind authenticated identity and writeback receipts through executable integration proof.
nonclaims: not a production Palantir authorization service
no property-level authorization is currently implemented
no external identity authentication is currently implemented
